# IFleetProxyInflightTracking
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IFleetProxyInflightTracking.sol)

**Inherits:**
IERC165

**Title:**
IFleetProxyInflightTracking

Interface for the FleetProxy contract which manages inflight withdrawal assets

Implements method to track in-flight withdrawal assets during bridging operations


## Functions
### updateInflightWithdrawals

Updates the inflight withdrawal assets amount when a bridge operation is executed

Called by authorized bridge components when withdrawal assets are transferred cross-chain


```solidity
function updateInflightWithdrawals(uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of withdrawal assets that are now in-flight|


### inflightWithdrawals

Returns the current amount of inflight withdrawal assets


```solidity
function inflightWithdrawals() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Amount of withdrawal assets currently in-flight|


### supportsInterface

Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`.

See ERC-165. Implementations must return true for IFleetProxyInflightTracking and IERC165 selectors.

```solidity
function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external view returns (bool);
```

## Events
### InflightWithdrawalsUpdated
Emitted when inflight withdrawal assets amount is updated


```solidity
event InflightWithdrawalsUpdated(uint256 amount);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The new amount of in-flight withdrawal assets|
